goal: Deployment approval gate: production deployments need an approval recorded before they run.
use: Deployment approval gate: production deployments need an approval recorded before they run. Use when a deployment to production is requested.

steps.note: Confirm production requires an environment approval in the pipeline.
Set the rule. The approver must differ from the change author.
Check the window. Deployments outside the agreed window need a second approval.
Check the record. Each approval links to the change and the test results.
Report. Each deployment, its approval status and any gap.
